Table 14.3.9.1 Time in days to ANC Recovery Post Nadir for Cycle 1– FAS
Note: Missing ANC values within the first 13 days of a cycle will be imputed using the method specified in SAP.
ANC recovery is defined as an ANC ≥2.0 × 109/L after the expected ANC nadir.
Nadir is the lowest ANC value observed in the first 13 days of a cycle.
If nadir point of ANC < 2.0 × 109/L during the first 13 days of a cycle, then time in days to ANC Recovery = (Start Date when ANC ≥ 2.0 × 109/L) – (Date of nadir in this cycle) +
1.
If ANC ≥ 2.0 × 109/L during the first 13 days of a cycle, then time in days to ANC Recovery equals to 0 days.

Note: Missing ANC values within the first 13 days of a cycle will be imputed using the method specified in SAP.
